mgmt_bio.text: Belen Garijo Lopez, born on July 31, 1960 in Almansa, Spain, is a physician by training who graduated in medicine from the University of Alcala in 1983 and began her career as a practicing doctor at La Paz hospital in Madrid before moving into the pharmaceutical industry. She became managing director of Aventis Spain in 2003 and, over roughly 15 years at Sanofi, served as vice president of pharmaceutical operations for Europe and Canada and sat on the executive committee, including as global integration leader for Genzyme after its acquisition by Sanofi. She joined Merck KGaA in 2011, held various roles there and spent five years as its chief executive, leading a turnaround of the Healthcare business through portfolio repositioning, R&D reorganization and commercial realignment that made Merck a global player in oncology and immunology.
